description.value: The Aurora Creek Marvel Pass trailhead is an access point into the backcountry of Mount Assiniboine Provincial Park, part of the Canadian Rocky Mountain Parks UNESCO World Heritage Site famed for its glaciers, alpine lakes, and peaks reaching 3,618 m. The park has no road access — trails are the only way in — making any visit a true wilderness undertaking. Bikepacking or mountain biking visitors would be entering a remote environment where self-sufficiency is essential, as services and facilities are absent across most of the park.
